radiusSource: Radius 1.415 Jupiter radii from Cortés-Zuleta et al. 2020 (2020A&A...636A..98C), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...636A..98C/abstract): 101,161.2 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius in the shared neutral gray. No image, color, map or oblateness of WASP-19 b is measured; only its size, mass and orbit are.
